title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return its maximum depth.

A binary tree's maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node down to the farthest leaf node.

Example 1:

Input: root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7]
Output: 3

Example 2:

Input: root = [1,null,2]
Output: 2

Constraints:

  • The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 104].
  • -100 <= Node.val <= 100

tests.name: Deep left leaf under balanced top
Deep right leaf under balanced top
Long left spine with null siblings
Long right spine with null siblings
Two node chain on left of right subtree
Two node chain on right of left subtree
Deeper left subtree than right subtree
Deeper right subtree than left subtree
